mapper.sql: achievement.achievement_id, achievement.management_no, achievement.teacher_user_id, owner.login_id AS teacher_name, achievement.organization_code, achievement.evaluation_year, achievement.management_item_code, achievement.achievement_date, achievement.achievement_status, detail.performance_content, detail.academic_year, CAST(detail.semester_code AS integer) AS semester, CAST(achievement.attachment_refs AS text) AS attachment_refs, achievement.created_at, achievement.updated_at

choose.when: AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_user_mappings requester_mapping JOIN organization_user_mappings target_mapping ON target_mapping.organization_code = requester_mapping.organization_code WHERE requester_mapping.user_id = #{requesterUserId} AND requester_mapping.status = 'ACTIVE' AND target_mapping.user_id = achievement.teacher_user_id AND target_mapping.status = 'ACTIVE' )

AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation_organization_mappings permission_mapping JOIN organization_user_mappings target_mapping ON target_mapping.organization_code = permission_mapping.organization_code WHERE permission_mapping.user_id = #{requesterUserId} AND permission_mapping.business_type = 'FACULTY_ACHIEVEMENT' AND permission_mapping.data_scope IN ('DEPARTMENT', 'COLLEGE', 'BUSINESS', 'ALL') AND target_mapping.user_id = achievement.teacher_user_id AND target_mapping.status = 'ACTIVE' )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM education_achievements achievement JOIN lecture_improvement_achievement_details detail ON detail.achievement_id = achievement.achievement_id JOIN users owner ON owner.user_id = achievement.teacher_user_id

SELECT
FROM education_achievements achievement JOIN lecture_improvement_achievement_details detail ON detail.achievement_id = achievement.achievement_id JOIN users owner ON owner.user_id = achievement.teacher_user_id WHERE achievement.achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND achievement.achievement_type = 'LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT' AND achievement.deleted_yn = 'N'

SELECT
FROM education_achievements achievement LEFT JOIN lecture_improvement_achievement_details detail ON detail.achievement_id = achievement.achievement_id JOIN users owner ON owner.user_id = achievement.teacher_user_id WHERE achievement.management_no = #{managementNo} AND achievement.achievement_type = 'LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT' AND achievement.deleted_yn = 'N'
SELECT mapping.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings mapping WHERE mapping.user_id = #{teacherUserId} AND mapping.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY mapping.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO education_achievements ( management_no, achievement_type, teacher_user_id, organization_code, evaluation_year, management_item_code, achievement_date, achievement_name, achievement_status, attachment_refs, deleted_yn, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{managementNo}, 'LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT', #{teacherUserId}, #{organizationCode}, #{evaluationYear}, #{managementItemCode}, #{achievementDate}, #{achievementName}, 'DRAFT', CAST(#{attachmentRefs} AS jsonb), 'N', #{createdBy}, #{createdBy} )

INSERT INTO lecture_improvement_achievement_details ( achievement_id, performance_content, academic_year, semester_code, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{achievementId}, #{achievementContent}, #{academicYear}, #{semesterCode}, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements achievement SET management_item_code = #{managementItemCode}, evaluation_year = #{evaluationYear}, achievement_date = #{achievementDate}, achievement_name = #{achievementName}, attachment_refs = CAST(#{attachmentRefs} AS jsonb), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE achievement.achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND achievement.achievement_type = 'LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT' AND achievement.deleted_yn = 'N'

UPDATE lecture_improvement_achievement_details detail SET performance_content = #{achievementContent}, academic_year = #{academicYear}, semester_code = #{semesterCode}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE detail.achievement_id = #{achievementId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO education_achievement_status_histories ( achievement_type, achievement_id, previous_status, next_status, action_type, reason_code, opinion, processed_by, processed_at ) VALUES ( #{history.achievementType}, #{history.achievementId}, #{history.previousStatus}, #{history.nextStatus}, #{history.actionType}, #{history.reasonCode}, #{history.opinion}, #{history.processedBy}, #{history.processedAt} )

INSERT INTO data_change_histories ( target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, changed_at, change_reason, request_id ) VALUES ( #{targetBusiness}, #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changedAt}, #{changeReason}, #{requestId} )
